title: BioIVT 'Other, specify' fields follow the canonical Other option
description: Repairs the show/hide rule on the four 'Other, specify' fields whose parent list was swapped for a canonical list. Each rule used the old list's value for Other ('OTHER', '6', 'other_race'), which no longer exists after the swap, so the specify field could never appear. Each rule now points at the canonical 'other' value. RACE is multi-select, so it uses selected().
rationale: Found 2026-10-04 by comparing every relevant/constraint/calculation expression against the real choice names with and without the bioIVT conventions: 8 rules broke (4 per study). Also repairs SHORTFORM/FOLLOWUP/OUTCOME RACE_OTH, whose rules were already pointing at a value that did not exist in the original lists.
source: Regression check of the BioIVT canonical-list conventions

history.note: Repairs a regression caused by the earlier canonical-list conventions; 'Other' also restored to canon_race and canon_cm_freq.
